Execute original native app-context requests on unrelated local H2 paths.

Synthetic request methods, paths, MIME fields and byte bodies pass through the
unchanged native header/default fragment and proprietary CEF adapter. Public
getters from the shipped CEF library supply the next stage, followed by its
URLRequest implementation and an independent hyper-h2 loopback peer. No Dart,
service-specific request producer, account or original application runs.

substitutions: Explicit synthetic methods, unrelated capture paths and opaque bytes replace service-specific producers; no service body semantics are claimed.
Actual native Collection DELTA supplies only noncredential app-context values; access/client token values are inert sentinels.

Original native header insertion/default-UA fragment, CEF adapter and locale/context producers execute unchanged under Unicorn; standard allocation/libc/libc++/UTF conversion and inert CEF interfaces are providers.
Original adapter fields are installed in shipped public CefRequest objects; their getters supply the later shipped-CEF URLRequest inputs.
Fresh roots, headless single-process bootstrap, inert helper, loopback authority and certificate bypass replace original startup; outer sandbox blocks remote traffic and user Library reads/writes.
limits: Explicit synthetic requests show the complete native app group survives unrelated GET/POST/PUT paths and the captured spelling variants; this does not establish app-side selection or entitlement for an arbitrary service route.
Binary body bytes are synthetic transport inputs; no protobuf/service producer or response behavior is proved.
Decoded H2 fields/sequence/raw target/body are captured; TLS fingerprint, HPACK frames, H3 and connection-reuse selection remain separate.
Explicit app Accept-Language overrides the independently produced CEF locale list for this bounded profile; this does not prove every managed-header override.
Case-variant duplicate replacement and decoded ordering are observed only for H2 here; no transfer of this sequence to H3 is established.
POST missing and empty Content-Type behavior comes from shipped public CEF execution, not a Spotify route-specific producer.
